AELIS firma líder y especializada en la prestación de servicios de valor añadido en el ámbito de los sistemas de información. Precisa incorporar al Equipo de Desarrollo para la oficina de Madrid o Toledo:

UN/A DESARROLLADOR/A JAVA en MADRID o TOLEDO

QUIÉN SOMOS:

AELIS es una consultora informática especializada en digitalizar los procesos de gestión de las empresas.

PUESTO Y MISIONES:

Dentro de un equipo joven y dinámico en un ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y estimulante, te incorporarás al equipo de Desarrollo para la realización de diferentes proyectos en el que se desarrollarán aplicaciones JAVA. Tus principales funciones serán:
• Análisis y planificación
• Diseño e implementación
• Mantenimiento de aplicaciones JAVA

Estudios mínimos
• Formación Profesional Grado Superior – Informática
• Idiomas: Inglés – Nivel medio

• Al menos 3 años de experiencia en un puesto similar

• Servidor de... aplicaciones Tomcat o similar

Conocimientos necesarios:
• Hipernate
• JPA
• JavaScript
• JQuery
• BootStrap
• SQL Server

LO QUE OFRECEMOS:
• Contrato indefinido.
• 22 días de vacaciones al año + 1 día a elegir entre el 24 o 31 de diciembre.

• Un equipo joven con diversos perfiles y habilidades donde se aprende de verdaderos expertos
• Oportunidad de crecer, desarrollar y construir una trayectoria profesional que se adapte a ti.

JOIN OUR TEAM

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Java EE
jobs_results.description:
¿Eres un apasionado del desarrollo Java?

Buscamos

Desarrollador Java Senior y Junior (50% teletrabajo/50% presencial en sus oficinas de Madrid, Sevilla y Palma)

Desarrollador Java Senior:

● 3 años de experiencia o más en desarrollo Java

● Tienes conocimientos y/o experiencia en API REST, servicios web SOAP y microservicios

● Estás familiarizado con trabajar con formatos de datos como JSON y XML

● Has trabajado con bases de datos relacionales SQL. Actualmente utilizamos Microsoft

SQL Server y PostgreSQL

● Tienes conocimientos y/o experiencia con bases de datos no relacionales NoSQL.

Actualmente utilizamos MongoDB y Redis (entre otras)

● Posees la capacidad (¡y virtud!) de escribir código de calidad, escalable y mantenible

● A la hora de programar sigues patrones conocidos, como Domain Driven Design (DDD) o

principios SOLID, y estándares de la industria

● Te suena o conoces herramientas y conceptos relacionados con tests como son las

pruebas unitarias, pruebas de... integración, cobertura de código, mocking, …

● Tienes experiencia usando algún sistema de control de versiones (usamos Git) y

herramientas de CI/CD

● Tienes habilidad y te motiva aprender nuevas tecnologías, herramientas y técnicas.

Desarrollador Java Junior:

● Tienes conocimientos de programación y ganas de ampliarlos. Sería ideal si tienes experiencia previa programando en Java

● Posees conocimientos básicos y algo de práctica de SQL

● Tienes experiencia usando algún sistema de control de versiones (usamos Git) y herramientas de CI/CD

● Tienes habilidad y te motiva aprender nuevas tecnologías, herramientas y técnica

En knowmad mood utilizamos la tecnología para estar cerca, nos profesionalizamos, investigamos, creamos y vendemos nuestras propias creaciones, nos certificamos, realizamos eventos, nos divertimos y además ayudamos a nuestros clientes a tener mejores procesos de producción.

¿Qué más se puede pedir? Pues además puedes contar con beneficios como:

- Formación en inglés para todos desde el primer día y formación en últimas tecnologías.

- Opción de retribución flexible (tickets restaurante, cheques guardería, tarjeta transporte, seguro médico) y certificaciones oficiales.

- Buen ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de desarrollo profesional en una empresa en crecimiento, organizada por centros expertos con identidad propia.

- Embajador de nuestra marca, a través de nuestro Plan Amigo.

- Eventos, meetups, techdays, charlas...Además de otros beneficios y sorpresas que vamos realizando a lo largo del año.

jobs_results.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
What We're Looking For Passionate and experienced software engineer, shaping and contributing to the future of NetSuite. An engineer who seeks the best code and processes in a holistic manner collaborating with PMs, UX colleagues and engineering. Working in a context where engineers have a common base (analytical, frontend, backend, quality & testing, etc.) while they can grow into specializations.

What You'll Do

Contribute and shape functional and technical challenges in the area defined as Acquire & Grow. Within the area, this particular team is responsible for the search service powering our commerce solutions. As well as providing lightning-fast page content, it also ensures that our customers' shoppers can find exactly the items that they are looking for via relevance scoring, faceting, and filtering. Search is at the heart of our commerce operations and one of the most critical parts of the application.

Beyond this specialized area, our team also belongs to the Acquire & Grow... department, which focuses on and contributes to other domain areas in NetSuite, such as customer engagement, order fulfillment, e-commerce and others.

You will be building new APIs, setting up new data models, coding new business logic as well delivering a bespoke user experience via the latest UI technologies. In short, you will work closely with other development teams, product management and the rest of engineering to define and implement a new product offering while ensuring the continued functionality of the existing system. Collaboration across international locations is going to be a key part of this role.

You will fit perfectly if you share these values and principles
• Open mind for discussion and team collaboration
• Drive to share the knowledge whenever possible
• Pride in your work and a desire to delight the customer should motivate you to take initiative, take responsibility, and take ownership of your projects
• A self-starter who can take a bit of directional input and then drive projects autonomously [but understands when to ask for help]
• Excellent communicator in both technical and non-technical contexts; office and company language is English
• A positive and resilient personality - you must be able to embrace feedback and have a desire for continuous iteration and improvement

Your qualifications & skills
• B.S or Master's in computer engineering or relevant experience in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math)
• Strong backend experience, including knowledge of Design Patterns and SOLID principles
• 3+ years’ software development experience particularly with Java or any other similar Object Oriented Programming language
• Drive for software design best practices and clean code principles
• Intimate with working and understanding of modern web applications from database to browser
• Strong drive for excellent software design and clean code principles
• Great problem-solving skills and ability to abstract functional requirements
• Flexibility to work with geographically distributed teams
• Work permit for Spain is required for this role

Preferred Skills
• Agile (Scrum, SCRUMBan, Kanban, …) experience
• Practical experience with managing and developing full-text search engines is considered a strong asset, and previous experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and Kibana is a plus
• Understanding of cloud-based distributed software applications

Why Oracle NetSuite?

Innovation starts with inclusion at Oracle NetSuite. We are committed to creating a workplace where all kinds of people can be themselves and do their best work. It’s when everyone’s voice is heard and valued that we are inspired to go beyond what’s been done before. An Oracle NetSuite career can span industries, roles, countries and cultures, giving you the opportunity to tackle new roles and challenges, while blending work and life.

Oracle NetSuite is the world's best cloud-based, multi-tenant ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) service with unified financials, supply chain, order management, omnichannel e-commerce...all in one platform!

We love quality, clean code and follow SOLID principles. We implement Agile (SCRUM), continuous improvement and self-management practices: code reviews, continuous integration, knowledge sharing, release retrospectives, incremental refinements, pair programming, … you name it! Our common language is English, both in the team and for communicating with our peers in Europe, the Americas and Asia.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

What we offer
• Agile environment – Start-up culture backed by a strong enterprise
• English-speaking environment and international team

items:
What We're Looking For Passionate and experienced software engineer, shaping and contributing to the future of NetSuite. An engineer who seeks the best code and processes in a holistic manner collaborating with PMs, UX colleagues and engineering. Working in a context where engineers have a common base (analytical, frontend, backend, quality & testing, etc.) while they can grow into specializations.

What You'll Do

Contribute and shape functional and technical challenges in the area defined as Acquire & Grow. Within the area, this particular team is responsible for the search service powering our commerce solutions. As well as providing lightning-fast page content, it also ensures that our customers' shoppers can find exactly the items that they are looking for via relevance scoring, faceting, and filtering. Search is at the heart of our commerce operations and one of the most critical parts of the application.

Beyond this specialized area, our team also belongs to the Acquire & Grow... department, which focuses on and contributes to other domain areas in NetSuite, such as customer engagement, order fulfillment, e-commerce and others.

You will be building new APIs, setting up new data models, coding new business logic as well delivering a bespoke user experience via the latest UI technologies. In short, you will work closely with other development teams, product management and the rest of engineering to define and implement a new product offering while ensuring the continued functionality of the existing system. Collaboration across international locations is going to be a key part of this role.

You will fit perfectly if you share these values and principles
• Open mind for discussion and team collaboration
• Drive to share the knowledge whenever possible
• Pride in your work and a desire to delight the customer should motivate you to take initiative, take responsibility, and take ownership of your projects
• A self-starter who can take a bit of directional input and then drive projects autonomously [but understands when to ask for help]
• Excellent communicator in both technical and non-technical contexts; office and company language is English
• A positive and resilient personality - you must be able to embrace feedback and have a desire for continuous iteration and improvement

Your qualifications & skills
• B.S or Master's in computer engineering or relevant experience in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math)
• Strong backend experience, including knowledge of Design Patterns and SOLID principles
• 3+ years’ software development experience particularly with Java or any other similar Object Oriented Programming language
• Drive for software design best practices and clean code principles
• Intimate with working and understanding of modern web applications from database to browser
• Strong drive for excellent software design and clean code principles
• Great problem-solving skills and ability to abstract functional requirements
• Flexibility to work with geographically distributed teams
• Work permit for Spain is required for this role

Preferred Skills
• Agile (Scrum, SCRUMBan, Kanban, …) experience
• Practical experience with managing and developing full-text search engines is considered a strong asset, and previous experience with Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, and Kibana is a plus
• Understanding of cloud-based distributed software applications

Why Oracle NetSuite?

Innovation starts with inclusion at Oracle NetSuite. We are committed to creating a workplace where all kinds of people can be themselves and do their best work. It’s when everyone’s voice is heard and valued that we are inspired to go beyond what’s been done before. An Oracle NetSuite career can span industries, roles, countries and cultures, giving you the opportunity to tackle new roles and challenges, while blending work and life.

Oracle NetSuite is the world's best cloud-based, multi-tenant ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) service with unified financials, supply chain, order management, omnichannel e-commerce...all in one platform!

We love quality, clean code and follow SOLID principles. We implement Agile (SCRUM), continuous improvement and self-management practices: code reviews, continuous integration, knowledge sharing, release retrospectives, incremental refinements, pair programming, … you name it! Our common language is English, both in the team and for communicating with our peers in Europe, the Americas and Asia.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.

What we offer
• Agile environment – Start-up culture backed by a strong enterprise
• English-speaking environment and international team
• Strong professionals around you that will help to accelerate your growth
• High-impact learning culture: free access to online learning platforms and regular in-house training sessions
• Continuous career development: we actively encourage and celebrate internal promotions

jobs_results.title: BACK DEVELOPER JAVA SPRING en Vigo
jobs_results.description:
Descripción

En Mercadona IT dirigimos y desarrollamos grandes proyectos que impulsan la digitalización de Mercadona, modernizando las aplicaciones ya existentes y desarrollando nuevas herramientas y productos que mejoran y optimizan los procesos de la compañía.

Para seguir creciendo con el mejor talento buscamos un Back Developer Java que esté familiarizado con SpringBoot y sea capaz de enfrentarse a retos de ingeniería y arquitectura de software de primer nivel, migración de sistemas productivos reales para nuestros trabajadores. Únete a nuestro equipo para liderar la transformación digital de los supermercados en España y Portugal. 🚀

El reto que te proponemos
• Diseñar y desarrollar servicios web RESTful y microservicios utilizando Spring Boot.
• Desarrollar e integrar servicios web con bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales. Así como diseñar e implementar modelos de datos utilizando Hibernate y JPA.
• Desarrollar pruebas unitarias y de integración utilizando herramientas... como JUnit, Mockito y Spring Test.
• Realizar documentación y mantenimiento del código.
• Trabajar con el equipo de Front-End para asegurar la integración y compatibilidad adecuada entre el Back-End y el Front-End.
• Investigar y mantenerse actualizado en las últimas tecnologías y tendencias en el desarrollo de aplicaciones Back-End en Java Spring.

Requisitos

Estudios: Grado en Informática / Telecomunicaciones o Ciclo en DAM / DAW.

Conocimientos:
• Imprescindibles

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Desarrollo de proyectos con uso de APIs JSON-REST.

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Conocimiento de Spring (Boot, MVC, Core, Security, Data, Batch...)
• Valorables

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Conocimientos en BBDD: Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Patrones de diseño POO

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- API REST

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Kafka

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Jenkins

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Docker

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Kubernetes

ㅤㅤㅤㅤ- Git

Experiencia

Desarrollo en Spring Boot de al menos 4 años.

Esta oferta es para ti si

Además de cumplir con los requisitos técnicos, eres una persona apasionada por la tecnología, orientada a la mejora continua, con una mente abierta para aprender siempre y generosa para apoyar y aportar al equipo.

Qué te ofrecemos
• Un entorno tecnológico de vanguardia para llevar a cabo proyectos de gran impacto de principio a fin.
• Formación continua tanto a nivel técnico como en competencias para mejorar tus skills.
• Un proyecto sólido, reconocido y lleno de posibilidades: aquí podrás crecer profesionalmente en la dirección que desees según tus aptitudes e inquietudes.
• Formar parte de un equipo compuesto por 1.000 personas, con una meta compartida: digitalizar la empresa líder de la distribución alimentaria en España desde dentro.

Salario

Retribución anual en función de la experiencia (a partir de 26.583€ brutos con proyección hasta 55.190€ brutos).

Si tú no tienes límites, nosotros tampoco.

ㅤ

#BeLimitless
